body.name: Finite-unsupported-row compatible RSCM class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{fin}}\) is the class of finite RSCMs over \(S\) and \(G\) that induce the source groundings \(Rsrc\) and target grounding \(\rho\) encoded by \(Ictx\), whose distinct exogenous variables are mutually independent, in which no ground endogenous variable has an exogenous relational parent and no non-relational exogenous variable is shared as a parent by distinct ground endogenous variables, whose finite mechanisms are type shared, that reproduce \(Psrc\), use the recovered rows \(K\) at every target-relevant positive-source-support key, and leave precisely the target-relevant keys in \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{free}}\) unrestricted over their native finite outcome alphabets.
